activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1637 as Descartes's representative Dutch intellectual-activity year: while living in the Dutch Republic, he published the Discours de la méthode together with La Géométrie at Leiden, linking his philosophical method with the algebraic treatment of geometry.

sources.title: René Descartes — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy records Descartes's move to the Dutch Netherlands by the end of 1628 and his major philosophical, mathematical, and scientific work there before his move to Sweden in 1649.

sources.title: Discours de la methode — Utrecht University Repository
sources.citation_text: Utrecht University records Descartes's Discours de la méthode as a 1637 book published at Leiden by Jan Maire.
